$Comment: The Foreman (DESIGN.md 6.1 to 6.4), the Heartworks' first elite (A4). Built from the Boilerback's template (from vanilla Template_Goblin_Glutton): evaluator-driven melee, leashes, the robots' rally and party health scaling. Added: idle life on his office (he inspects the line, blows his whistle at nobody); the Whistle (vanilla Template_Dungeon_Goblin_Scrapper's pack enrage: 1.2 s, then his Coglings within 12 are Overdriven for 8 s; every 18 s); Call the Line at 75% and 50% (vanilla Template_Trork_Chieftain's backup, here a signal to the room's Cogling hatches); Overtime at 50% (vanilla Skeleton_Elite's phase change, done in the role: 2 s invulnerable while he throws off his coat-plate, an Appearance swap, then faster attacks and the Steam Dash). Built by tools/models/heartworks/foreman.data.mjs.

Instructions.$Comment: Scale health to the party size on first aggro (the dungeon goblins' tiers: x1.55, x2.1, x2.65).
Standard detection: the robots' rally beacon, sight and sound (crouching players are not heard).

Combat: the evaluator (CAE_Machinaria_Heartworks_Foreman) runs the wrench and the throw; his lanes run the whistle, the calls and Overtime.
Hard leash first and ungated (from the Glutton).
The soft leash must not interrupt the dash or Overtime.

OVERTIME at 50% (once): invulnerable 2.1 s, he heaves at his coat-plate and flings it off (the Appearance swaps to the coat-less model under a burst of plates and steam), roars, calls the line again; then the Overtime action set. Latched by a flag so the blocking lane survives its own state change (as vanilla scrappers do).

The blast lands: every Cogling of his within 12 is Overdriven.
